title: Chapter 1087
paragraphs: Chapter 1087
Episode 255. The Death of Kelliark Zipfel, and....(4)
The moment Malugia spoke, Focal lowered her head and gritted her teeth.
[Your guess... was correct, Jin. Malugia wanted me to help her.]
If so, it meant the possibility of escaping the immediate danger of annihilation had increased.
However, Focal could not be happy at all. Not just because of the instinctual revulsion that came from supporting Malugia, but because it could be the beginning of an even greater catastrophe.
To Focal, Malugia was a more fearsome being than Kelliark. She had only followed Jin's opinion now because there was no other choice.
'...Did Malugia just smile?'
Jin, who was about to answer, momentarily felt Malugia's gaze. Her eyes and the corners of her mouth, which seemed to be smiling, were so chilling that his body felt as if it were freezing.
Kelliark, on the other hand, was frowning for the first time.
From the beginning, he had no intention of eliminating Malugia. His plan was to push her to the brink of annihilation and then capture her for the resurrection of 'Kinzelo'.
Recalling his battles with other Malugias, he had thought it was a more than possible task.
“You were hiding your strength, Malugia...”
The Malugia of this world was different from the Malugias of other dimensions he had subjugated until now.
She was stronger and more cunning. The moment Malugia began to unleash her sun energy again, Kelliark had no choice but to admit that he had made a mistake.
'My coming to this world alone was a misjudgment from the start. I was hasty. I overreacted because of the growth rate of Jin Runcandel... and the Vamel Alliance.'
Unlike him, Malugia had been preparing everything from the beginning.

She had used this world's Zipfel to induce the Vamel Alliance to launch an all-out offensive, and in that process, she had made the power of the Sun God egos that the Vamel Alliance had acquired overflow onto the battlefield.
That power, as Jin had predicted, had an effect on the interference between dimensions, and the Kelliark of the 33rd dimension had used that as a foothold to cross over to this world.
She had perfectly seen through the plans of the Demon Army and Kelliark. The fact that they were preparing to cross over to this dimension directly to trample the Vamel Alliance.
[Keuk, graaaaaah...!]
At the sudden scream, Jin flinched and turned his head.
It was Focal's scream. She was trembling, clutching her head, and sun energy was draining from her body.
Malugia was extracting her sun energy.
[Kggghaaaa... Malugia...! What trick did you use when you accepted my power!]
[I merely synchronized with you for a moment. Thanks to that, I have become able to open the gate, so I am grateful.]
Focal could not resist Malugia's power at all. Her knees buckled, and she was panting as if her breath would be cut off at any moment.
“Lord Focal!”
Jin reflexively extended his sword towards Malugia. It was true that he had to use her, but being dragged around like this was not good.
However, before his sword-aura could even extend, Jin first had to strike away a ray of light that had suddenly flown in from Kelliark.
'He aimed for Lord Focal?'
For some reason, the moment the situation unfolded, Kelliark was aiming for Focal with top priority. Soon, Jin was able to realize the reason.
'The gate Malugia said she could open, don't tell me she meant another dimension...!'
He was correct.

Malugia was now trying to use Focal's power to open a gate to another dimension. To strike the main forces of the unified Zipfel, which had sent only its leader and strongest fighter to this world first.
Therefore, Kelliark had urgently tried to strike Focal. Because he had to sever the connection between Malugia and Focal first.
[It is already too late.]
Tzaaaaaak...!
A dull, squelching sound was heard in everyone's ears, as if a honeycomb had been grabbed and split in half.
Above Kelliark's head, a massive rift was opening.
It was a dimensional gate on a scale that everyone on the battlefield, even Kelliark who had reigned as the hegemon of all dimensions, had never seen before.
The scenery seen beyond it looked as if the Milky Way were flowing, just like Malugia's eyes. Kelliark gritted his teeth and glared at Malugia.

Malugia had already performed a short-distance spatial jump and taken a position in front of the dimensional gate. Kelliark also matched her altitude and extended a hand that held some unknown magic, but Malugia did not allow the attack as meaninglessly as before.
A golden shield that had spread in layers in an instant was pushing back Kelliark, who had stuck close to Malugia.
Kelliark tried to approach again, forcefully tearing apart the shield with both hands, and the pattern of Malugia holding him back while sending her sun energy into the dimensional gate continued.
Jin and his companions could know, without facing it directly, the sun energy that was pouring into the dimensional gate. That was, literally, a power that could erase the world.

That power was heading for the headquarters of the unified Zipfel, which were spread out like branches between the dimensions. Although Jin could not see that far, he could infer it to some extent from the sight of Kelliark desperately trying to stop her.
Although Kelliark was not being pushed back in battle or taking a fatal wound, the initiative of the battlefield had completely passed to Malugia.
At times, Kelliark's spatial explosions and unknown grand magics would directly strike Malugia, but she paid them no mind and continued her attack beyond the dimension.
On the outside, it was not a very horrific scene.
Not a single drop of blood was shed; just Malugia's body and shield, which looked like a giant structure, were being repeatedly destroyed and regenerated by Kelliark's power.
However, everyone could tell. Not just the Genesis Knights, including Jin, but anyone watching that sight could instinctively sense it.

The fact that while Malugia was pouring her sun energy into the dimensional gate, in real time, a dimension existing somewhere, their world, was being destroyed, or suffering a comparable amount of damage.
Those dimensions must surely resemble this world. Just because the Demon Army ruled them did not mean that everyone living in that dimension was evil like them.

There would surely be innocent deaths, and their number would be countless. Malugia was carrying out those numerous deaths and destructions with an indifferent face. As if just pouring oil into an ant hill and setting it on fire. As if there was no need to even recognize that it was a cruel and horrific act.
The kingdoms of the Demon Army, everything that Kelliark had built, was being destroyed. Anyone experiencing such a thing would have their inner self shaken and collapse.

However, he too showed no sign of being engulfed in despair or sadness at all. It was not because he thought that his main forces could withstand Malugia's sudden attack by any means. They would surely suffer uncontrollably great damage.
“Did you think I would be pained by that, Malugia. You should have rather used that power to strike me. It seems to be a power you cannot use twice.”
After all, if he just conquered this world now, it would be the end. No matter how many dimensions he had already conquered were destroyed.
Furthermore, as Kelliark felt it, it was impossible to eliminate all the complete Origin Stones with that power. If it had been unfolded right in front of him, it might have been a different story.
“Still, I will admit you landed a blow. So, what is next? With what will you surprise me again?”

The shockwaves of the sun energy were growing fiercer. In response, Kelliark's magic power was also amplified, and just from the aftereffects, the stationary golden ships were beginning to be shot down one by one.
[Haak, heok...!]
“Lord Focal, are you alright!”
Focal barely nodded. Jin looked at the falling golden ships and repeatedly tried to communicate, but all the communicators were dead.
If they were to retreat, the chance was now.
'It was Kelliark who stopped the Golden Fleet's power... The fleet's power sources can only return if they can suppress his power even for a moment.'
There were two choices.
To abandon the fleet and the crew and retreat with only the key personnel, or to throw a gamble by striking Kelliark so that everyone could escape together somehow.
The deliberation was not long.
Sssreung...!
Sigmund was drawn from its sheath. Jin's heart of light was burning a vivid blue. And Vahn was the first to sense that energy and immediately recognized the choice her brother had made.
“Yes, if we retreat like this, there will be no next time anyway. Let's go, Brother Jin.”
“The power will return soon. All fleets, prepare for escape!”
Vahn and Jin shouted.
Since it was a matter of course, there was no need to hide the fact that they were trying to escape from the enemies. What was needed now was the belief that they could all survive together.
No matter how horrific and powerful an enemy appeared, the will to somehow shove a sword into their body.

The Genesis Knights began to move towards the front of the dimensional gate. With each step they took, a pressure as if their entire body were being torn apart came upon them, but the more it did, the more fiercely they advanced.
Walking, running, rushing.

Jin, Vahn, and Luna closed the distance with Kelliark in an instant. Kelliark, until then, had been so busy dealing with Malugia that he had no room to pay attention to the coalition's Genesis Knights.
However, from the moment two of the Plutonian Domination Swords were unfolded simultaneously, Kelliark had to start distributing his power.
Within the sun energy and Kelliark's magic that filled the entire battlefield, two storms were rising up like cores.
Plutonian Battle God Sword Technique, 10th Sword
Plutonian Domination Sword - Wave
Chzzzz... Chalbak...!
The sea, which had been shining gold the whole time, was turning blue and pure white. A vivid blue ripple was spreading out from the two ultimate techniques as their center.

In between, the sight of the darkness of the spiritual energy spread by Murakan and the sharp light of crimson intertwining also followed. That power was already reaching the point where Kelliark and Malugia were clashing.
Although its size was smaller than the clashing sun energy and magic, the Genesis Knights were not being pushed back, nor were they collapsing, nor were they in disarray.
They were striding confidently between Malugia and Kelliark.
